location: INT. HEART O' THE CITY HOTEL 4
summary: Inside the hotel room, the Big Cop moves to handcuff Trinity while the other cops hold their aim. Trinity moves with inhuman speed, punching the Big Cop in the nose until his nose explodes and kicking him into another cop. The remaining cops fire wildly as Trinity snatches a gun from a cop's hand, twists it, and fires. The exchange ends with Trinity standing alone and a flashlight falling to the floor.

what_changes.before: In custody of the police, hands behind head
what_changes.after: Free, standing alone after a violent struggle
Kicked back, nose exploded, flying into another cop

event_hint.one_line: Trinity overpowers the police officers who raided her room.
